title: Now open: Leo's FunZone — kids' play space & toy shop
summary: Leo's FunZone is now open at 601 Crystal Fall Parkway, Unit 200 in Leander. The family destination combines imaginative play areas, a DIY craft studio, premium toys and birthday parties. Details and hours at leosfunzone.com.

title: Now open: Oak & Steel Barbershop on US-183
summary: Oak & Steel Barbershop is now open at 2036 US-183, Suite 300 in Leander, offering haircuts, fades, beard trims and kids' cuts seven days a week. Book online at oaksteeltx.com or call (512) 986-4040.

title: Recycling collection delayed on Wednesday, Oct. 21
summary: 10/21/2026 - Wednesday recycling collection in some Leander neighborhoods will be delayed until Thursday. Please leave your carts out so Clawson Disposal can collect the recycling on Thursday.

title: Early voting begins Monday, Oct. 19
summary: 10/16/2026 - Early voting for the Nov. 3 General and Special Elections begins Monday, Oct. 19, and ends Friday, Oct. 30.

title: Leander discontinues funding Flock contract
summary: 09/04/2026 - The City of Leander will discontinue funding its contract with Flock, following the directive by the Leander City Council during its Sept. 3, 2026 meeting.

title: City Council approves agreement with CenTex Sports for major sports complex
summary: 09/21/2026 - CenTex Sports plans to invest $100 million for a state-of-the-art sports complex in Leander.
